The Admiral: The infection spread. What began as angry red welts on room and the captain bloomed into something worse. Pulsing patches that throbbed in time with your heartbeats. Healing magic slides off like oil. Dispel magic does nothing. The thing inside your veins is awake, and it's testing the walls. In the strange, timeless drift of the astral plane, where thought itself can move you and sounds arrive before their makers, you had one short day to search for answers. One day before the flotilla. And an unknown day before whatever's growing inside decides to bring itself to the surface. Room tried everything he could, from protection from poison, and greater restoration, but the marks only darkened and the ache only deepened. The captain sought wisdom from Elder Abarrett, and though no help, he spoke of names and heraldry, gifting the captain with a gift-sized mask to wear when phasing his people. Not as a conquering hero, But as a mysterious and nameless captain sliding into the flotilla. It was Lumi who ventured into stranger waters. Twice he's spoken the words vile darkness, and twice the shadow entity appeared. First reading from its Book of Smoke and Ash, revealing cryptic truths. Then, through the Divine Spell… then, later, through the Divine Spell Commune, reaching out to his mom, watching from beyond. Three questions he posed. Is there anyone currently on the ship who knows how to cure us? No. will reach the flotilla before they're taken over by the infection? Unclear. Is my father Vecna? No Her visage fading, the infection spreading. And through the silvery void we see it. Not a star, but a small planet of ships, the Gif Flotilla. An astral fortress of hundreds of thousands of vessels. Layered and spread in three dimensions, bristling with cannons and standards, the thunder of distant artillery. At its heart, the great flagships. At its edges, repair yards, mess halls, patrol craft, and vendors from countless worlds beyond. An entire civilization drifting through the Astral Sea as one. It's the largest gathering of gifts in centuries. A city of mercenaries and soldiers, glory and judgment. And somewhere, deep within the maze of steel, plank, and canvas, someone… Who might be able to save you?
